# Draft:Hannah Wardell

Hannah Wardell is an American opera singer and attorney.
Education
Hannah Wardell graduated from the University of Maryland Francis King Carey School of Law, Juris Doctor, cum laude, 2023. Prior, Hannah Wardell studied at the Peabody Conservatory, Master of Music, Vocal Performance, 2018 as well as achieving an undergrad at Shepherd University with as Bachelor of Music, Vocal Performance, sum cum laude, 2016.
Career
Hannah Wardell maintains a thriving voice studio teaching students of all ages. As a voice teacher, Hannah's goal is to guide her students in finding their true voice. Her teaching focuses on a foundational understanding of pedagogy that stresses the importance of healthy singing. By utilizing traditional techniques and incorporating an instilling understanding of the anatomy of the voice with her students, Hannah allows her students to reach their maximum potential.
Hannah Wardell Practices law as an Associate in the General Litigation Group. Hannah Wardell received her J.D. with a certificate in Cybersecurity & Crisis Management from the University of Maryland Francis King Carey School of Law evening program in 2023. While in law school, she participated in the Federal Immigration Appellate Clinic where she worked with her team to draft an appellate brief that went before the Second Circuit. Hannah Wardell was a research assistant for the Center for Health and Homeland Security, and was a member of the Entertainment, Art, and Sports Law Association as well as the Student Bar Association. Hannah Wardell was a CALI Recipient (Estate Planning Seminar) and a Finalist at the Villanova Law Pro Football Negotiation.
Productions
Teresa in Bellini's La Sonnambula Romeo in Bellini's I Capuleti e i Montecchi, The Princess in Dargomyzhsky's Русалка (Rusalka), Polina in Tchaikovsky's Пиковая дама (The Queen of Spades), Cherubino in Mozart's Le Nozze di Figaro, The Third Lady in Mozart's The Magic Flute, Dorabella in Mozart’s Così fan tutte, Iolanthe in Gilbert and Sullivan’s Iolanthe, and The Sorceress in Purcell’s Dido and Aeneas. In addition to opera, Hannah is an avid performer of art songs, and has been recently granted the "Rubinstein Award" from the "Triumph International Russian Competition" based out of Philadelphia.
In December 2025, "The Snow Queen" a Fairy Tale Family Musical by H. C. Andersen.

Villagers, Snowflakes, Flowers, Arctic Birds, Robbers, Bel Cantanti Children's Studio, The Four Season Dancers.
